name: Kaitlan Collins
biography: Kaitlan Collins (born April 7, 1992) is an American journalist who currently serves as anchor of The Source on CNN.[3][4] She is the former co-anchor of CNN This Morning and also served as the network's White House Correspondent until 2022. Previously, she was the White House correspondent for the website The Daily Caller.
